_about: Dorothy Mills's histories for young readers (Putnam): The Book of the Ancient World (1923), The Book of the Ancient Greeks (1925), The Book of the Ancient Romans (1927). US public domain as published before 1931; Mills died 1959, so UK copyright runs to 2029. IA scans, raw OCR.
